message.content:
Below is a **ready‑to‑go “Trip Planner”** you can copy into your notes app or print out as a PDF.  
Feel free to tweak dates, add personal preferences, or let me know what kind of traveler you’re – I’ll adjust it instantly!

---

## 📅 7‑Day Itinerary (Mid‑April)

| Day | Morning | Afternoon | Evening |
|-----|---------|-----------|--------|
| **1 – Arrival & Settling In** | Arrive at Charles de Gaulle / Orly → take RER B + Metro Line 5 to your hotel. Check‑in & unpack. | Walk around *Le Marais* – cafés, vintage shops, Place des Vosges. | Dinner at **L’As du Fallafel** (cheap yet iconic). Night walk along Seine’s banks. |
| **2 — Classic Landmarks** | Louvre Museum (early opening 9 am) – skip lines via online ticket. | Lunch near Palais Royal, then stroll through Jardin des Tuileries. Visit Notre-Dame Cathedral (exterior only due to restoration). | Opera Garnier tour (if available) or dinner at **Café de la Paix**. |
| **3 — Art & Culture** | Musée d’Orsay (Impressionist masterpieces). | Picnic lunch at Champ de Mars, then Eiffel Tower (reserve tickets for summit). | Light show at Eiffel Tower (free after sunset). |
| **4 — Montmartre & Sacré-Cœur** | Climb up to Basilique du Sacré‑Coeur early morning. Explore artists' square. | Lunch at Le Consulat, wander Rue Lepic. Take a short tram ride back downtown. | Sunset cruise on the Seine (Bateaux Mouches). |
| **5 — Palace of Versailles** | Full‑day excursion to Versailles (train RER C from Saint‑Germain‑en‑Laye). Tour Hall of Mirrors, Gardens, Grand Trianon. | Return to Paris late afternoon. Relax at Luxembourg Gardens. | Casual dinner at **Bouillon Chartier** (budget friendly). |
| **6 — Foodie Day** | Breakfast at **Du Pain et des Idées** (croissants & pain au chocolat). Market tour at Marché Bastille. | Cooking class (French pastry workshop). | Wine tasting at **La Cave à Michel**. |
| **7 — Departure** | Pack & last‑minute souvenir shop at Galeries Lafayette. | Grab croissant & coffee before heading to airport. | Fly home! |

> **Tip:** Buy a **“Paris Pass”** (includes museum entry, public transit, hop‑on hop‑off boat tour). Great value if visiting many paid attractions.

---

## 🏨 Accommodation Options  

| Category | Example Hotels/Hostels | Price Range (€ per night) | Why Choose This? |
|----------|-----------------------|----------------------------|------------------|
| Luxury | Hôtel Plaza Athénée, Four Seasons George V | €800+ | Iconic service, rooftop views. |
| Boutique | Hotel Henriette (Marais), La Maison Rose (Montparnasse) | €200–€350 | Unique décor, central location. |
| Mid‑Range | Hotel Ekta (Champs‑Élysées), Mama Shelter (Belleville) | €120–€180 | Comfortable rooms, good amenities. |
| Budget | Generator Paris (Latin Quarter), St Christopher's Inn Gare du Nord | €30–€70 | Social vibe, clean basics. |
| AirBnB | Studio in Canal Saint-Martin, Loft in Belleville | €80–€150 | Local feel, often cheaper than hotels. |

> **Booking tip:** Book well in advance (especially for summer months); use flexible cancellation policies when possible.

---

## 🚆 Getting Around Paris  

| Mode | How to Get Started | Cost (per single journey) | Notes |
|------|--------------------|---------------------------|-------|
| Metro/Subway | Purchase a **carnet** of 10 tickets (~€16.90) or a daily unlimited pass (**Navigo Découverte**) ~€14.50 | Unlimited rides within zones 1‑2 | Fastest way to move between neighborhoods. |
| Bus | Same carnet applies | Free once you have a valid ticket | Good for scenic routes. |
| Vélib′ Bike Share | Rent a bike at stations across city | €0.35/minute + €1.40/hour | Ideal for short trips, especially during sunny afternoons. |
| Taxi/Rideshare | Apps: Uber, Bolt, Chauffeur Privé | €15–25 depending distance | Convenient for late nights or heavy luggage. |
| Walking | Most sights cluster together | Free | Best for exploring streets, markets, hidden corners. |

> **Pro Tip:** Download the **Citymapper** or **RATP** apps for real‑time navigation and fare calculations.

---

## 🍽️ Dining Highlights  

| Dish | Where | Approx. Cost |
|------|-------|--------------|
| Croissant & Café au lait | Du Pain et des Idées | €3–$4 |
| Escargot | L’Arpège | €12–$20 |
| Steak Frites | Chez Georges | €18–$24 |
| Crêpes | Breizh Café | €8–$12 |
| Macarons | Ladurée | €5 each |
| Cheese Board | Fromagerie Barthélémy | €15–$22 |
| Street Food (Falafel, crepe, kebab) | Various street stalls | €3–$6 |

> **Budget Hack:** Order meals off‑menu (“hors menu”) where locals eat—they're usually cheaper.

---

## 🎟️ Must‑See Attractions (Skip‑the‑Line Tickets)  

| Attraction | Ticket Type | Time Slot | Suggested Booking Window |
|-------------|-------------|-----------|--------------------------|
| Louvre | Standard Entry | Early morning (e.g., 9:00 AM) | 48 hours ahead |
| Musée d'Orsay | Online Advance | Late afternoon | 72 hrs ahead |
| Eiffel Tower Summit | Reserved Seating | Noon | 96 hrs ahead |
| Arc de Triomphe | Guided Audio Tour | Anytime | 24 hrs ahead |
| Sainte-Chapelle | Combined Ticket w/ Conciergerie | Morning | 48 hrs ahead |
| Disneyland Paris | Park Hopper | Any day | 60 days ahead |

> **Note:** For most major monuments, booking online saves hours waiting in line.

---

## 💰 Budget Breakdown (Per Person, 7 Days)

| Item | Estimated Cost (€) |
|------|-------------------|
| Flights (roundtrip) | 300–600 |
| Airport Transfer (taxi/ride share) | 45 |
| Accommodation (mid-range) | 900 |
| Meals (average €30/day) | 210 |
| Transport Passes | 100 |
| Entrance Fees | 140 |
| Miscellaneous (souvenirs, extra snacks) | 75 |
| **Total** | **≈€2,050** |

> Adjust numbers upward/downward based on chosen lodging tier or dining preference.

---

## 🌍 Practical Tips Before You Go  

| Topic | Advice |
|-------|--------|
| Currency | Euro (€). Credit cards widely accepted; carry small cash for markets. |
| Language | Basic French phrases help; English spoken in tourist spots. |
| Safety | Keep valuables secure; beware pickpockets in crowded metros. |
| Weather (April) | Average temp 11°C–17°C; pack layers, umbrella, light jacket. |
| Connectivity | SIM card $10-$15 for data; Wi-Fi common in cafes/hotels. |
| Health | Travel insurance covering medical evacuation advisable. |
| Cultural Etiquette | Greet politely ("Bonjour"), say thank-you ("Merci"). |

---

### Quick Checklist (Pack List)

- Passport + visa documents
- Flight tickets & confirmations
- Hotel reservations & address
- Printed copies of attraction tickets
- Power adapter (Type E/F)
- Reusable water bottle
- Small backpack for day trips
- Comfortable shoes (walking required!)
- Umbrella/raincoat
- Snacks for long train journeys

---

#### Want More Customization?

Let me know:
- Your preferred travel style (luxury vs. budget).
- Interests (art, gastronomy, architecture, nature).
- Number of people traveling.
- Desired departure month/year.

I’ll tailor this planner further—just drop a quick note!
